title: 第9章 洞察入微第10章 运气不错
content_zh:
岳青山跟着道：
“韩林！这位赵师兄，可是八大开荒队伍的队长之一！”
“知道什么是开荒队伍吗？就是主干道开采的先头部队。”
“前面但凡有好东西，那都已经被他们挖掘了一遍的！”
“如果不加入，就只能在后面喝风，一个月下来，你可能连一块青花玉也挖不着。”
“而且，赵师兄还是云中郡郡王之子，背景强大！以你的垃圾天赋，这辈子都别想出头，倒不如跟他混，将来即便修行没着落，还能回到世俗，混个一官半职！”
岳青山，神色傲然地望着韩林，看似劝说实则在拍赵锐凌的马屁。
韩林倒是没想到，这岳青山，竟然还有这么一面。
心中对岳青山，生出了些许厌恶。
不仅仅是这副小人得志的做派，更多的是岳青山好像管不住自己的嘴，竟把自己的九灵根天赋拿出来说事，甚至可能当成炫耀的资本，告诉给了赵锐凌等人。
他淡淡瞥了岳青山一眼，转头对赵锐凌道：“我想，加入你们队伍，不是没有条件的吧？”
赵锐凌轻轻一笑：“当然了，加入我的队伍，你每天的收获，要分九成给我！”
九成？
韩林摇摇头，“抱歉了师兄，我还是在这后面捡漏吧。”
赵锐凌脸色顿时冷了下来：“韩林，你可要想好了。即便我抽走九成，也绝对比你在后面一颗挖不到的强！”
“而且，机会就这一次，如果你不答应，以后就算求着加入，我也不会再收你的！”
岳青山也跟着道：“韩林，赵师兄能亲自招揽你，不知是你几世修来的福分，可别不知好歹，你看看你自己这张脸，除了赵师兄，谁看了不嫌弃？”
“够了！”
韩林目光一冷，“你们走吧，我要开始干活了。”
“呵呵，好，好！”

“你这丑八怪倒是挺硬气的，但最好，能一直硬气下去！”
“我们走！”
赵锐凌气得脸上青一阵红一阵，说罢一甩衣袖，怒然而去。
“不识好人心啊。”岳青山一副你活该的表情，讥讽地望了韩林一眼，也连忙追着赵锐凌等人追去。
韩林自认已经习惯被人冷嘲热讽，却也被刚才这一幕气得不轻，狠狠吐了几口闷气，才终于让自己平静下来。
随后拿着锄头，就开始挖掘。
眼前这一面墙壁主要是风化石，虽不像沙土那么松软，但也不是完全挖不动。
韩林一锄锄下去，很快就挖出一个七尺高，三尺宽的洞道。
倒不是他不想把洞道挖的更大，而是到了这个宽度，周围又是坚硬的石壁，根本挖不动，只能向前。
此时洞道已有丈许深，韩林累的满头大汗，于是坐下来休息。
脑海之中，回想起昨晚修炼的场景。
虽然，接近凌晨时，他成功开悟，觉醒了神识。
可随后在法界内修炼了数个时辰，气脉第一个关卡，也没有任何突破迹象。
一是因为，石屋内灵气太过稀薄，并且每次吸收之后，都需要很长时间才能恢复过来，灵气供应不足。
第二则是天赋的原因。他的关卡突破难度极高，就好像铜墙铁壁一样，归元劲撞在上面当当作响，一点痕迹都没留下。
想到此处，韩林不知不觉将眉头皱了起来。
“想靠自然灵气，循序渐进的修炼，恐怕我真要困死在练气一层。”
“如今看来，也只有努力赚积分，兑换灵石，或许还有一线希望。”
content_en:
Yue Qingshan followed:
"Han Lin! This Senior Brother Zhao is one of the captains of the eight major wasteland reclamation teams!"
"Do you know what a land reclamation team is? They are the vanguard of main road mining."
"If there is any good stuff ahead, they have already discovered it!"
"If you don't join, you'll have no choice but to stay behind. In a month, you may not even be able to dig out a piece of blue and white jade."
"Moreover, Senior Brother Zhao is the son of the Prince of Yunzhong County and has a powerful background! With your rubbish talent, you will never get ahead in this life. You might as well hang out with him. Even if your practice fails in the future, you can still return to the secular world and work as an official!"
Yue Qingshan looked at Han Lin proudly, appearing to be persuading but actually flattering Zhao Ruiling.
Han Lin didn't expect that Yue Qingshan actually had such a side.
He felt a little disgust towards Yue Qingshan in his heart.
Not only was he acting like a villain, but more importantly, Yue Qingshan seemed to be unable to control what he said and actually used his Nine Spirit Root talent to speak out. He might even use it as a way to show off and told Zhao Ruiling and others.
He glanced at Yue Qingshan lightly, turned to Zhao Ruiling and said: "I think joining your team is not without conditions, right?"
Zhao Ruiling smiled softly: "Of course, join my team, and you will give me 90% of your daily gains!"
Ninety percent?
Han Lin shook his head, "I'm sorry, senior brother, I'd better pick up the leaks from behind."
Zhao Ruiling's face suddenly turned cold: "Han Lin, you have to think carefully. Even if I take away 90%, it will definitely be better than the one you can't dig out at the back!"
"Besides, this is your chance. If you don't agree, even if you beg to join me in the future, I won't accept you again!"
Yue Qingshan also followed: "Han Lin, Senior Brother Zhao is able to recruit you personally. I don't know if it is a blessing you have cultivated for several lifetimes. Don't be ungrateful. Look at your own face. Apart from Senior Brother Zhao, who doesn't dislike it?"
"Enough!"
Han Lin's eyes turned cold, "You guys go, I'm going to start working."
"Haha, okay, okay!"
"You ugly monster is quite tough, but it's best if you can keep being tough!"
"Let's go!"
Zhao Ruiling was so angry that her face turned blue and red. After saying this, she flicked her sleeves and left angrily.
"You don't know the heart of a good person." Yue Qingshan looked at Han Lin with a look that said you deserved it, and quickly chased after Zhao Ruiling and others.
Han Lin thought that he was used to being ridiculed, but he was very angry at the scene just now. He took a few deep breaths before finally calming down.
Then he took a hoe and started digging.
The wall in front of me is mainly made of weathered stone. Although it is not as soft as sand, it is not impossible to dig.
Han Lin dug a hoe and soon dug a hole seven feet high and three feet wide.
It wasn't that he didn't want to dig the tunnel bigger, but it was this wide and surrounded by hard stone walls, so he couldn't dig it at all and had to move forward.
At this time, the cave was already about ten feet deep. Han Lin was sweating profusely from exhaustion, so he sat down to rest.
In my mind, I recalled the scene of last night's practice.
Although, towards the early hours of the morning, he successfully became enlightened and awakened his spiritual consciousness.
But after practicing in the Dharma Realm for several hours, there was no sign of breakthrough at the first level of Qi Meridian.
One is because the spiritual energy in the stone house is too thin, and it takes a long time to recover after each absorption, so the spiritual energy supply is insufficient.
The second reason is talent. His level was extremely difficult to break through, just like an iron wall. Guiyuan Jin clanged against it without leaving any trace.
Thinking of this, Han Lin frowned unconsciously.
"If I want to rely on natural spiritual energy and practice step by step, I'm afraid I will really be stuck at the first level of Qi training."
"Now it seems that the only way is to work hard to earn points and exchange them for spiritual stones. Maybe there is a glimmer of hope."
